dedupe_keys.name: dechets d equipements electriques et electroniques sur vgp

description: Déchets d'équipements électriques et électroniques sur VGP is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Communauté d'Agglomeration Versailles Grand Parc. Waste Electrical and Electronic Equipment (WEEE) refers to all appliances that operate with battery, battery or electricity. They must therefore be deposited in shredders or at the permanences. Coverage: Communauté d'Agglomeration Versailles Grand Parc. The portal shows the English title as "Waste electrical and electronic equipment on VGP" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Communauté d'Agglomeration Versailles Grand Parc. Its keywords include vgp, opendata, environnement, pav, geospatial. The listing shows 6 download or service links in CSV, WEB PAGE, GEOJSON, KML. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
